candidates.test_objective: Verify that Vcmd remains within the specified voltage limits for a positive low-speed reference.
candidates.precondition: Initialize the MIL model at rest and apply the listed SpeedRef value for the complete simulation interval.
candidates.expected_behavior: The maximum Vcmd shall not exceed +12 V and the minimum Vcmd shall not be below -12 V over the complete simulation interval.
candidates.rationale: Exercises the positive, low-magnitude reference partition for voltage limitation.
